fish.name: Angelfish
fish.description: Angelfish (Pterophyllum Scalare) are diamond shaped fish with laterally compressed bodies, long trailing fins, and grow to around 5-7 inches in length. They typically live 8-12 years and can reach full size in 6-12 months under good conditions. Behaviorally they are considered semi-aggressive but are generally calm.
fish.info: Angelfish can live in both freshwater and saltwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 30 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 6.8-7.8, a temperature of around 78-84 °F, and a DKH between 3-8.

fish.name: Betta Fish
fish.description: Betta fish (Betta Splendens) also known as Siamese fighting fish have elaborate fins that have a diverse range in colors and grow to 2-3 inches. The betta fish only has a 3-5-year life span. Despite their solitary and territorial behavior, they are a low maintenance pet and can even be trained to do simple tricks.
fish.info: Betta fish live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 5 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 6.5-7.5, a temperature of around 74-84 °F, and a DKH between 3-5.

fish.name: Cherry Shrimp
fish.description: Cherry Shrimp (Neocaridina Davidi) are small invertebrates with a translucent to bright (cherry) red coloration. They grow to about 1-1.5 inches in length and typically live for 1-2 years reaching maturity around 2-3 months. They are peaceful scavengers that graze on biofilm and algae.
fish.info: Cherry Shrimp live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 1 gallon to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 6.4-8.0, a temperature of around 65-85 °F, and a DKH between 0-10.

fish.name: Chocolate Chip Starfish
fish.description: Chocolate Chip Starfish (Protoreaster Nodosus) are recognizable by their tan or brown bodies covered in dark and raised tubercles (small, rounded nodule, bony protrusion, or knobby lump found on bones, skin, or organs) that look like chocolate chips. They reach up to 12-14 inches in length and live typically for 5-10 years. They can be predatory to coral but are slow-moving scavengers.
fish.info: Chocolate Chip Starfish live in saltwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 50-75 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a salinity of 1.020-1.026 specific gravity, a PH ranging between 8.1-8.4, a temperature of around 72-78 °F, and a DKH between 8-12.

fish.name: Clownfish
fish.description: Clownfish (Amphiprion Ocellaris/Amphiprion Percula) are brightly colored with orange bodies, white bands, and black edging on the fins. They typically live for 6-10 years, reaching 3-4 inches within 1-2 years. Behaviorally they are highly territorial and semi-aggressive.
fish.info: Clownfish live in saltwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 10 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a salinity of 1.020-1.026 specific gravity, a PH ranging between 7.5-8.2, a temperature of around 75-82 °F, and a DKH between 8-12.

fish.name: Corydoras
fish.description: Corydoras (Corydoras) are small, armored bottom-dwelling catfish with rounded bodies, barbels (slender, whisker-like sensory organs located near the mouth used for finding food by taste or touch in murky water) around the mouth, and various patterns per species. They grow around 1.5-3 inches in length within 6-12 months and live around 5-10 years. They spend most of their time scavenging the substrate in peaceful schools.
fish.info: Corydoras live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 4 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 6.0-7.5, a temperature of around 74-80 °F, and a DKH between 2-10.

fish.name: Danios
fish.description: Danios (Danio Rerio) are slender and quick with horizontal striping or spotted patterns. They live for 3-5 years reaching 2-4 inches in length within a few months. They are a very active schooling fish that should be kept in groups and have constant swimming activity.
fish.info: Danios live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 2 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 6.8-7.8, a temperature of around 64-75 °F, and a DKH between 3-8.

fish.name: Goldfish
fish.description: Goldfish (Carassius Auratus) have a wide variety of body shapes and colors. They grow to 6-12+ inches depending on type and environment within 1-3 years and live for 10-20. Behaviorally they are social, messy, and curious that require strong filtration systems and space.
fish.info: Goldfish live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 20 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 7.0-8.4, a temperature of around 68-74 °F, and a DKH between 4-8.

fish.name: Guppy
fish.description: Guppies (Poecilia Reticulata) are small with vivid color variations and fan shaped tails in males; they are also live-bearing fish. They typically live for 2-3 years, growing around 1.5-2.5 inches in length within a few months. They are peaceful and active fish that are popular as beginner aquarium fish for being prolific breeders.
fish.info: Guppies live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 2 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 7.0-8.0, a temperature of around 72-82 °F, and a DKH between 8-12.

fish.name: Helfrichi Firefish
fish.description: Helfrichi Firefish (Nemateleotris Helfrichi) are slender and have a striking lavender and yellow coloration with elongated dorsal fins. They grow to 2-3 inches within 6-12 months and typically live for 5-7 years in a well-maintained aquarium. They are shy and peaceful fish that often stay near hiding places that can quickly move when startled.
fish.info: Helfrichi Firefish live in saltwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 15 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a salinity of 1.020-1.025 specific gravity, a PH ranging between 8.1-8.4, a temperature of around 72-79 °F, and a DKH between 8-12.

fish.name: Killifish
fish.description: Killifish (Fundulopanchax, Nothobranchius, and more) have vibrant coloration and streamlined bodies. They can live between 1-5 years depending on species and can reach 1.5-3 inches. Behaviorally they can be peaceful or semi-aggressive and show strong territorial and breeding behaviors.
fish.info: Killifish live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 5 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 6.0-7.0, a temperature of around 68-75 °F, and a DKH between 7-10.

fish.name: Neon Tetra
fish.description: Neon Tetra (Paracheirodon Innesi) have iridescent blue stripes and bright red coloration along the lower body. They reach 1-1.5 inches within a few months and can live for 5-8 years. They are a peaceful schooling fish that stay in large groups and are synchronized swimmers.
fish.info: Neon Tetra live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 5 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 6.8-7.8, a temperature of around 75-80 °F, and a DKH between 3-8.

fish.name: Nerite Snail
fish.description: Nerite Snail (Neritina Natalensis, Neritina Pulligera, and others) are brackish snails with hard, rounded shells with striped or spotted patterns. They live for 1-3 years, growing to about .5-1 inch. They are peaceful algae grazers that do not reproduce in aquariums.
fish.info: Nerite Snail can live in both freshwater and saltwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 5 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 7.5-8.5, a temperature of around 72-78 °F, and a DKH between 2-12.

fish.name: Otocinclus
fish.description: Otocinclus (Otocinclus) are catfish with streamlined bodies and poses a sucker mouth adapted for grazing algae. They grow up to 1-2 inches in length within 6-12 months and typically live for 3-5 years. Behaviorally they are peaceful schooling fish that spend their time cleaning leaves or tank surfaces.
fish.info: Otocinclus live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 3 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 6.5-7.5, a temperature of around 72-79 °F, and a DKH between 6-15.

fish.name: Rasbora
fish.description: Rasbora (Rasbora Borapetensis, Rasbora Caudimaculata, and more) are small and slender featuring subtle metallic or triangular markings. They grow to about 1-2 inches reaching maturity in a few months and live for 4-6 years. They are active mid-water swimmers that are peaceful schooling fish.
fish.info: Rasbora live in freshwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 2 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a PH ranging between 6-7, a temperature of around 73-82 °F, and a DKH between 2-15.

fish.name: Royal Gramma
fish.description: Royal Gramma (Gramma Loreto) have a distinct half-purple, half-yellow coloration with compact bodies. They typically live for 5-7 years reaching around 3 inches in length. Behaviorally they are generally peaceful but are semi-aggressive towards similar species that often hide near crevices.
fish.info: Royal Gramma can live in saltwater and require a fully cycled tank of at least 30 gallons to maintain stable water conditions. Their specific water requirement needs are a salinity of 1.020-1.025 specific gravity, a PH ranging between 8.1-8.4, a temperature of around 72-78 °F, and a DKH between 8-12.
